title: Denza (BYD Group's luxury brand) launches the D9 seven-seat electric MPV in India at Rs 90 lakh ex-showroom (13 Nov 2026; one fully loaded FWD version; 115.07 kWh, 730 km claimed NEDC, nine airbags, 0-100 km/h 8.5 s; about Rs 10 lakh above the MG M9 from Rs 79.94 lakh); Z9 GT at Rs 1.57 crore; bookings open; Denza-only showrooms in Gurugram, Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad
